verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Wally's API is OpenAI-compatible (base_url swap works with official OpenAI clients) and that the same CLI can run models fully offline/locally without an account, implying a local server could serve models in this way. However, the OpenAI-compatible claim is documented specifically under 'wally-cloud/api.md' and never explicitly re-stated for the local/offline mode, so there's no direct evidence a locally-loaded model exposes that same OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Missing for 10: explicit docs/example showing a local server flag (e.g. `wally serve`) exposing an OpenAI-compatible endpoint for on-device models, and any hands-on confirmation of this local server working.
